actions.action: Store claims with explicit evidence scope.
actions.mechanism: Structured population, outcome, timeframe, and context prevent similar wording from collapsing differently scoped findings.
actions.implementation: Require exact stored passage IDs for every claim. Extract scope only from supplied passages; mark unspecified fields unknown rather than inferring them.
actions.check: Enter similar claims with different populations and opposing findings; verify separate records retain their populations, directions, and passage IDs.
actions.risk: Overly rigid fields may obscure qualifications; retain passage wording.

actions.action: Show disagreement separately from scope differences.
actions.mechanism: Pairwise evidence relationships distinguish comparable opposition, differently scoped findings, and unresolved comparability without ranking source truth.
actions.implementation: Add a comparison view with scope columns and user-confirmed relationship labels. Treat absent evidence as unassessed, never opposing evidence.
actions.check: Different-population opposing claims must display scope differences; same-scope opposing claims must display disagreement. An empty evidence slot must remain unassessed.
actions.risk: Incomplete scope can mislead comparisons; default uncertain pairs to unresolved.

actions.action: Compile briefings through a citation-and-scope gate.
actions.mechanism: Statement-level validation blocks unsupported generalization and makes relevant disagreement visible instead of smoothing it away.
actions.implementation: Draft only from supplied passages. Require exact passage IDs per statement, scope confirmation, and acknowledgment of linked opposition before export.
actions.check: Attempt an all-populations conclusion from opposing population-specific claims; block export until separate scoped statements appear with their supporting IDs.
actions.risk: Validation cannot establish truth; users must review semantic support.

actions.action: Keep original passages beside the working briefing.
actions.mechanism: An embedded source inspector preserves report context while users verify citations and compare conflicting passages.
actions.implementation: Open citation IDs in a workspace side panel showing exact stored text, report identity, and stored passage order; allow two passages side-by-side.
actions.check: From each opposing briefing statement, open its cited passage without navigation away; verify displayed text matches the stored ID exactly.
actions.risk: Unavailable surrounding text must be marked unavailable, not reconstructed.
